title: I’m building a Card Battler where an AI Game Master narrates every play
author: SurrealEverything
selftext:
https://reddit.com/link/1plzeqb/video/05hh1h0n427g1/player

  
Hello! I’m sharing the first public alpha of **Moonfall**.

This is an experiment that asks: **What happens if we replace complex game mechanics with intelligent simulation?**

Cards don't have stats, they are **characters in a story**. When you play a card, an **AI Game Master** analyzes the narrative context to decide the outcome in real-time.

It's a "soft launch" Alpha (Desktop/Browser).

**Play the Demo:** [https://diffused-dreams.itch.io/moonfall](https://diffused-dreams.itch.io/moonfall)

I'd love to know if the game feels fair or if the AI GM is too unpredictable!

comments.author: AxiosXiphos
comments.body: Fascinating concept. I'll try this out later.

comments.author: Visible-Key-1320
comments.body: Really cool concept and pitch, but I do not understand what I'm doing as I play. Really needs a tutorial.

comments.author: JonFawkes
comments.body: An interesting idea, certainly something that can only reasonably be done with AI. Kinda reminds me of season 1 yugioh

replies.author: SurrealEverything
replies.body: That was also an inspiration for me. I really want the battles in card games to come alive!

comments.author: Roth_Skyfire
comments.body: Looks very interesting, may give this a try.

comments.author: Will_X_Intent
comments.body: This is what I want from gaming in the future, the underlying systems to interpret and adapt based on the actions of the player.  Unfortunately, everyone is up in arms against ai so this game probably won't do well.  But it's getting closer to my dream world.

comments.author: xJohn_Snow
comments.body: Replacing traditional card stats with an AI Game Master that decides outcomes based on narrative context is really fresh. The unpredictability adds excitement, though balancing fairness might be tricky. The idea of cards as characters in a story is compelling and opens up unique gameplay possibilities. For more detailed feedback or suggestions, consider uploading your alpha to [vibecodinglist.com](http://vibecodinglist.com), where developers and players can provide deeper insights on mechanics and narrative flow. Also, feels like it's easy to play than Yu-Gi-Oh because even with no knowledge in card game understand the flow
